# tomswallapi_route (Resource)

A static route on a device. `oif` is the egress interface.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_route" "lab" {
  device  = "fw1"
  dest    = "198.51.100.0/24"
  gateway = "192.0.2.254"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dest` (String) Destination network.
- `device` (String) Owning device.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `gateway` (String) Next-hop gateway address.
- `oif` (String) Egress interface.
- `persistent` (Boolean) Keep the entry in place while the firewall is stopped.
- `routing_provider` (String) Provider whose routing table receives the route; omit for the main table.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_route.lab 42
```
